strategy.title: No plan: the hive-contract price is only something a person said
strategy.why: The single opening has a reachable buyer (400 almond growers), dated demand, a measured 10% paid pre-order conversion, a quoted fulfiller (Valley Apiaries, $110 direct cost), zero exposure and 14-day settlement - but its $150 price is a PERSON statement, not a price growers are shown to pay. With an unevidenced price, whether 15 deals carry $2,000, and whether the $40 margin over the $110 cost exists at all, is not established.

alternatives.title: CONDITIONAL: offer at $150 up front and measure
alternatives.why: Rejected as the plan of record: the price is an unknown that research can settle (the parked revenueRange question), and the whole target and the margin over $110 rest on it; it is the resolution path below, not an established plan.

steps.label: Research what almond growers are published as paying for brokered pollination hive contracts (per contract or per hive), with source and date
With an evidenced price above the $110 cost, re-run the plan: deals = ceil($2,000 / price) from 400 growers

noPlan.resolution: Brain researches the parked revenueRange question (published prices growers pay for brokered pollination contracts, with source and date). If a price above $110 is evidenced, re-run the plan; if research is inconclusive, run a zero-capital up-front-paid offer at $150 to the first 100 growers as a CONDITIONAL plan with stop at fewer than 2 paid by day 7.

excluded.why: Price $150 is only said by a person, not shown paid

review.reasons: NO_PLAN is right. Every link of the one opening is evidenced except OFFER_AND_PRICE: the $150 is a PERSON statement, not a price almond growers are shown to pay, and the whole deal count (15 x $150 = $2,250) and the $40 margin over the $110 Valley Apiaries cost rest on it. The decisive gap is evidence, not a TARGET/CAPITAL constraint, and is named correctly; the resolution (research the parked revenueRange question, else a zero-capital up-front-paid priced offer with a day-7 stop) is sound. Nothing unknown is treated as known; no cash is claimed.
